Home / Dashboard
👑 Dashboard

See the whole team at a glance with the Project Dashboard.

An admin tab visible to all users (only the User List is admin-only). Your projects show up automatically, and API calls happen only from the Data Management tab.

📊

Bulk Add Sheet

Register multiple tasks at once, spreadsheet-style. Supports pasting ranges from Excel and auto-linking parent tasks by pasting a URL.
📊

Per-Project Dashboard

KPI cards (completion rate, health score) / Velocity & priority matrix / Previous- and last-week comparison views
📋

All Tasks

Lists every task in the project. Includes inline cell editing and a pin button
📈

Gantt

A project-wide Gantt Chart. Same UI as the personal Gantt, lightning line included
🌐

Cross-Space Summary

Instant aggregation from cache. Automatic at-risk project detection and a cross-milestone view
👥

Everyone's Workload

Aggregates hours across every assignee in the space. Overtime/completed-hours bar chart, with zero extra API calls
📦

Data Management

API calls happen only on this tab. Active/inactive classification excludes projects you don't need to fetch
👤

User List (admin only)

See every user's last login status. Accounts inactive for over a year are highlighted in red, and you can remove them from the space directly
🏢

Organization

Register a department tree, assign projects to it, and analyze projects by department

Prep your weekly report in minutes.

Health score, completion rate, and delay hours are all aggregated automatically, so you can compare them side by side.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage all your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. With 7 display views and a Project Dashboard, everyday task management and tracking team progress become effortless.
